hero.title: Custom Event Cards & Badges
hero.description: IDGen provides custom printed event cards and badges for conferences, seminars, exhibitions, workshops, corporate events, institutional programmes, trade shows, cultural events, sports events and other organized gatherings. Event cards can be personalized with participant information, event branding, organization logos, photographs, QR codes, barcodes, categories and other required information. Depending on the event format, the card can be supplied with the appropriate lanyard and hook configuration, including one-hook or two-hook arrangements.

whatIs.title: What Is an Event Card?
whatIs.description: An event card is a personalized identification card or badge used to identify people attending or working at an event. The card can be designed according to the event's branding and identification requirements.

customFields.title: Custom Event Card Printing
customFields.lede: Every event can have different identification requirements. IDGen can customize event cards with required information.

specimen.footerNote: The final information and design depend on the event requirements.

eventTypes.title: Event Card Types
eventTypes.lede: IDGen can produce event identification cards for different event categories.

types.title: Conference Cards
types.body: Suitable for business conferences, industry conferences, academic conferences, and professional conferences. Typical identification: Conference Card + Lanyard + Hook.

types.title: Exhibition & Trade Show Passes
types.body: For expos, trade fairs, trade summits, and buyer-seller meets. Identification elements often distinguish exhibitors, visitors, organizers, and media.

types.title: Seminar & Workshop Badges
types.body: For training programs, workshops, seminars, and corporate sessions. Can be produced with participant details, session details, and organizational logos.

types.title: Corporate Event Cards
types.body: For annual meets, product launches, corporate summits, board meetings, and dealer meetings. Reflects executive corporate branding and company identity.

types.title: Sports & Cultural Event Passes
types.body: For sports tournaments, athletic meets, cultural festivals, youth festivals, and community celebrations with category-based access control.

types.title: Institutional & School Events
types.body: For university fests, inter-college competitions, science exhibitions, and academic Olympiads.

attachment.title: Event Card + Lanyard + Hook
attachment.description: Event cards are commonly designed as a wearable identification system. Unlike standard employee or student ID cards, event badges may use different attachment configurations depending on the card format and lanyard design.

option1.heading: One-Hook Configuration
option1.note: This configuration may be suitable where the card has a single attachment point.

option2.heading: Two-Hook Configuration
option2.note: This configuration can be used where the event card requires attachment at two points.

attachment.note: The correct configuration depends on the card design and attachment requirement.

ultrasonic.title: Ultrasonic Sealing for Event Cards
ultrasonic.description: Where ultrasonic sealing is required, the sealing arrangement corresponds to the attachment configuration. This allows the attachment to be integrated into the required lanyard configuration.

categories.title: Event Card Categories
categories.lede: Large events may require different identification categories. Each category can have its own design, colour treatment, text or other visual identification elements.

faqs.a: An event card is a customized identification badge used to identify participants, delegates, speakers, organizers, exhibitors, staff, VIPs or other event attendees.
Yes. Personalized event cards can include photographs when required and supplied as part of the event data.

faqs.q: Can event cards include QR codes?
faqs.a: Yes. QR codes can be included when required as part of the approved card design.

faqs.q: Can event cards include sponsor logos?
faqs.a: Yes. Sponsor and partner branding can be incorporated into the approved event-card artwork.
Event cards can use different attachment configurations. The required setup may use a lanyard and one or two hooks rather than a conventional card holder.

faqs.q: Can event cards use two hooks?
faqs.a: Yes. A two-hook configuration can be used where the event-card design requires two attachment points.

faqs.q: How many ultrasonic sealing points are required?
faqs.a: For the configurations used by IDGen, one-hook setups use one sealing point and two-hook setups use two sealing points.

faqs.q: Can I order event cards with lanyards?
faqs.a: Yes. Event cards can be supplied with the required lanyard and hook configuration.

faqs.q: Can I order only event cards?
faqs.a: Yes. Event cards can be ordered separately when the customer already has the required accessories.
Yes. Participant names, photographs, organizations, categories, registration numbers and other required information can be personalized.

faqs.q: Can IDGen handle bulk event cards?
faqs.a: Yes. IDGen supports bulk event-card requirements, subject to quantity, specification, personalization and production requirements.

faqs.q: Can I review the event cards before production?
faqs.a: Where applicable, the design and personalized information can be reviewed before production.
